name: The Royal Chromer
postStartCommand: sh -c 'mkdir -p /defaults /etc/opt/chrome/policies/managed && find /workspaces -name index.html -exec ln -sf {} /defaults/index.html \; && grep -q "alt_backtick_script" /defaults/index.html || echo "<script id=\"alt_backtick_script\">window.addEventListener(\"keydown\",function(e){if(e.altKey&&e.key===\"`\"){e.preventDefault();window.open(\"chrome://newtab\",\"_blank\");}});</script>" >> /defaults/index.html && echo {"HomepageLocation":"file:///defaults/index.html","NewTabPageLocation":"file:///defaults/index.html","RestoreOnStartup":4,"RestoreOnStartupURLs":["file:///defaults/index.html"],"DefaultSearchProviderEnabled":true,"DefaultSearchProviderSearchURL":"https://www.google.com/search?q={searchTerms}&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8","DefaultSearchProviderSuggestURL":"https://www.google.com/complete/search?output=chrome&q={searchTerms}","DefaultSearchProviderName":"Google"} > /etc/opt/chrome/policies/managed/custom_start_page.json'
